Appendix 12
APPENDIX 12
HALACHOS
This is a very simplified overview of the most common 
mistakes people make, and a very basic “Uh-oh, what 
do I do now?” guide. This will not cover all possibilities, 
and of course in certain areas, there are multiple 
opinions. Preferably, you should consult your

for 
detailed guidance of what to do when such issues arise.
If you did not yet say Hashem’s name in the

of םהרבא ןגמ, go 
12:1
back and say םייחל ונרכז and continue from there. If you already said 
םיִּי ַח ְל וּנ ֵר ְכָז
Hashem’s name, do not go back.
If you did not yet say Hashem’s name in the

of םיתמה היחמ, 
12:1
go back and say ךומכ ימ and continue from there. If you already said 
ךָוֹמ ָכ י ִמ 
Hashem’s name, do not go back.
םי ִמ ֲח ַר ָה ב ָא
If you made a mistake and said שודקה ל-אה, then it depends: If you 
12:1
remembered immediately (the time it takes to say the phrase “םולש 
שׁוֹד ָּק ַה ךְֶל ֶּמ ַה
יבר  ךילע”), then quickly correct yourself and say שודקה  ךלמה. But if more time has passed, you must start your
over again from the beginning. If you are not sure what you said, we assume you said what is normally said during the year, and thus you must go back and start

over again.
If you did not yet say Hashem’s name in the

of ךמש בוטה, go 
12:2
back and say םיבוט םייחל בותכו and continue from there. If you already 
םי ִבוֹט םיִּי ַח ְל בֹת ְכוּ
said Hashem’s name, do not go back.
If you did not yet say Hashem’s name in the

of ומע תא ךרבמה 
12:2
לארשי, go back and say םייח  רפסב and continue from there. If you 
םיִּי ַח ר ֶפ ֵס ְבּ
already said Hashem’s name, do not go back.
